product_one_liner.value: CoLab is an AI-powered design-review and engineering knowledge platform for mechanical engineering and product-development teams, helping them review CAD and drawings, capture feedback, and make faster design decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and product overview describe AI-powered design reviews, engineering feedback and faster decisions for engineering teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers demo and sales contact routes but no public pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: All four are named on CoLab's customer page, which includes case studies or customer-specific descriptions.

employee_band.notes: A current CoLab VP, Demand Generation listing says the company has grown to over 250 employees.

hq_location.notes: CoLab identifies St. John's, Newfoundland as its headquarters/base.

founded_year.notes: The company profile and CoLab's about information identify 2017 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is made up of product, use-case, industry and marketing content; it does not show at least two posts by engineers explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage exposes Support/API routes, but I could not verify a public documentation or help-center site with several articles, nor establish that none exists.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current job listings include Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer and Sales Engineer; neither title matches the specified AI, ML, data-science or related role-title criteria.

model_provider.value: Anthropic and OpenAI (the company names these as AI-service providers; no specific model names are publicly identified in the pages checked).
model_provider.notes: CoLab's security/privacy material names Anthropic and OpenAI among providers powering AI features but does not specify a model name.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page explicitly claims SOC 2 and ISO 27001. It also names other certifications, but they are outside the requested list of five.

last_funding.notes: CoLab announced a $72 million USD Series C on November 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The November 10, 2025 Series C falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live postings include Business Development Representative and Key Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The product-updates index lists the new Knowledge Home feature on October 14, 2026; CoLab also announced its major CoLab 4.0 release on July 9, 2026. Both are inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A May 6, 2026 announcement says Tom Greever joined as SVP of Design and Jessie Wheeler as SVP of Operations.

crm_stack_signal.notes: CoLab's Revenue Operations Systems job listing names these CRM, sales-engagement, conversation-intelligence, data-enrichment, marketing and business-intelligence systems.
